title: Evaluation of Outcomes Using the AMO Advanced Customvue™ iLasik Procedure
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy, predictability and safety of the Advanced CustomVue™ iLASIK procedure (WaveScan WaveFront® System, STAR S4 IR™ Excimer Laser System and IntraLase™ FS System). Patient data will be collected electronically and analyzed to determine improvements in postoperative visual acuity, visual quality and residual error.
